description: This file defines the internal class ActivationWorkingSet, which manages recently active grain activations in the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for tracking activation states, observers for state changes, and lifecycle participation logic.

classes.name: ActivationWorkingSet
classes.description: Manages a set of recently active grain activations, tracking their states, and notifying observers.

methods.name: OnActivated
methods.description: Adds a member to the working set and notifies observers.

methods.name: OnActive
methods.description: Marks an existing member as active and notifies observers.

methods.name: OnEvicted
methods.description: Removes a member from the working set and notifies observers.

methods.name: OnDeactivating
methods.description: Handles the deactivating event by removing member and notifying observers.

methods.name: OnDeactivated
methods.description: Handles the deactivated event and notifies observers.

methods.name: MonitorWorkingSet
methods.description: Periodically scans the working set to remove idle members.

methods.name: VisitMember
methods.description: Determines if a member should be removed or marked idle.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the working set to the silo lifecycle for start/stop handling.

methods.name: LogExceptionVisitingWorkingSetMember
methods.description: Logs exceptions that occur when visiting a working set member.
